n6cc4ab2565.headline: U-POWER, UPDATER Start Joint Renewable Power Procurement
n6cc4ab2565.summary: The two Japanese power retailers will cooperate on renewable sourcing, electricity sharing and offsite power purchase agreement operations, seeking more stable prices and clearer traceability.
n6cc4ab2565.why: Power retailers buy electricity for customers, and renewable procurement agreements affect their costs, pricing stability and sustainability reporting.

nfecaef152e.headline: New Zealands government plans to cut  14 pc of public sector jobs to slash spending
nfecaef152e.summary: New Zealand's government will lay off nearly 9,000 public sector workers, 14% of public sector jobs, by mid-2029 to slash spending, Finance Minister Nicola Willis said.
nfecaef152e.why: Government spending cuts affect fiscal deficits, government bond issuance and the broader domestic economy.

n0a6fef6de8.headline: Mitsotakis: Coca-Cola 3E Investment a Productivity Leap
n0a6fef6de8.summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis hailed Coca-Cola 3E's Schimatari PET plant as a symbol of industrial revival, announcing tax cuts, reforms and €3.1bn in co-financed investment.
n0a6fef6de8.why: Coca-Cola HBC, operating as Coca-Cola 3E, is a major bottler whose plant investments affect its production capacity and costs.

n6de7fe70f7.headline: Four killed as Kenya fuel protests spark nationwide strike
n6de7fe70f7.summary: Four people died and more than 30 were injured in Kenya protests over fuel price hikes, which have spurred a nationwide strike.
n6de7fe70f7.why: Fuel prices shape transport costs and inflation across East Africa, and unrest can disrupt trade and business activity.

ndd4cb83380.headline: ADMIE €1B Raise & GSI Progress
ndd4cb83380.summary: ADMIE's CEO confirmed the timeline for a €1 billion capital raise and signalled momentum for the Greece-Cyprus-Italy interconnector, which has EU backing.
ndd4cb83380.why: ADMIE is Greece's electricity transmission system operator, and its capital raising funds grid projects that connect Greece to neighbouring markets.

n445a8e76c9.headline: US Moves to Drop Case Against Billionaire Who Offered $10B
n445a8e76c9.summary: The US is moving to drop a case against Gautam Adani, who was accused of bribery and fraud. Adani is described as a supporter of President Trump.
n445a8e76c9.why: Gautam Adani chairs the Adani Group, a major Indian conglomerate with listed companies in ports, power and infrastructure, so US legal developments affect its investor sentiment.

n6f914f88be.headline: Renovate Program: Eligibility Starts May
n6f914f88be.summary: Eligibility checks for Greece's €500 million Renovate programme begin at the end of May via gov.gr. The scheme targets vacant homes built before 1990.
n6f914f88be.why: State-funded renovation programmes support construction activity and the property market, which matter for Greek economic growth.

nbc7f00ce7a.headline: Kenya Names Adan Mohamed as New KRA Commissioner General
nbc7f00ce7a.summary: Adan Abdulla Mohamed was appointed Commissioner General of the Kenya Revenue Authority on May 18 for a three-year term. The appointment followed a decision by the National Treasury Cabinet Secretary.
nbc7f00ce7a.why: The Kenya Revenue Authority collects the country's main taxes and customs duties, so its leadership affects revenue policy and enforcement.

n9169762aa0.headline: Rupee falls 18 paise to 96.38  against US dollar in early trade
n9169762aa0.summary: The rupee opened weaker and fell 18 paise to 96.38 against the US dollar. A strong dollar, rising US Treasury yields and simmering geopolitical tensions weighed on sentiment.
n9169762aa0.why: The rupee is India's currency, and its exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and foreign investment flows.
n9169762aa0.why_moved: A stronger US dollar and rising US Treasury yields pulled the rupee lower, with geopolitical tensions adding pressure.

n940cac5395.headline: Japan economy grows faster than expected in first quarter
n940cac5395.summary: Japan's economy grew faster than expected at the start of 2026, official data showed. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is considering an extra budget as inflation concerns grow over the Middle East war.
n940cac5395.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its growth and fiscal policy affect the yen, Japanese government bonds and the Bank of Japan's policy path.

nbc4b128b3c.headline: Stellantis joins race to build mini-EVs for Europe
nbc4b128b3c.summary: Stellantis, owner of the Jeep and Fiat brands, said it will start building smaller, low-cost electric cars for Europe. The announcement was made on Tuesday.
nbc4b128b3c.why: Stellantis is a major global automaker, and its entry into affordable EVs reflects competition in Europe's electric vehicle segment.

impacts.name: Stellantis
impacts.why: The company plans a new low-cost EV line for Europe, which could affect its product mix and competitive position.

nb4fa928d4f.headline: RM5 Billion Lifeline For SMEs As Govt Moves To Cushion Impact Of Global Supply Shock
nb4fa928d4f.summary: Malaysia rolled out RM5 billion in financing for small and medium enterprises and is considering diesel subsidy reforms. The move comes as inflation edges up amid rising fuel costs.
nb4fa928d4f.why: Government support for SMEs and fuel subsidy policy influence domestic inflation, consumer demand and the fiscal position.

nabcaffe6ca.headline: Indias edible oil imports rise 3 pc in FY26 on  Nepal duty-free surge, industry body says
nabcaffe6ca.summary: India's edible oil imports rose 3% to 166.51 lakh tonnes in fiscal 2025-26, driven largely by a sharp jump in duty-free imports from Nepal, according to the Solvent Extractors Association.
nabcaffe6ca.why: India is one of the world's largest importers of edible oils, so its import volumes influence global vegetable oil prices and trade flows.

nf3053d6c7e.headline: Fujitsu, SMBC Group and SoftBank agree on alliance to build Japan-made platform for sustainable healthcare
nf3053d6c7e.summary: Fujitsu, SMBC Group and SoftBank agreed an alliance to build a Japan-made platform for sustainable healthcare. The companies aim to extend healthy life expectancy and curb national healthcare costs.
nf3053d6c7e.why: Fujitsu is a major Japanese IT services company, while SMBC and SoftBank are large financial and telecom groups with growing technology investments.

n3b8819a5e4.headline: Eltek Ltd. Reports 2026 First Quarter Financial Results
n3b8819a5e4.summary: Eltek Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed maker of printed circuit boards, announced its financial results for the first quarter of 2026.
n3b8819a5e4.why: Eltek is a manufacturer of printed circuit boards used in electronics, so its results indicate demand in the electronics supply chain.

n8e66cf49cf.headline: Infosys cuts Q4 bonus payouts after up to 100% variable pay in previous quarter: Report | Company Business News
n8e66cf49cf.summary: Infosys reduced performance bonus payouts for Q4 FY26 to an average of 70 percent, down from 85 percent in Q3, amid uncertainty in the global tech sector over AI.
n8e66cf49cf.why: Infosys is a major Indian IT services exporter, and variable pay levels reflect its performance and pressure from AI on traditional IT services.

nfc381a8e15.headline: Indian Airlines Ask Refiners to Postpone Local Jet Fuel Price Hike
nfc381a8e15.summary: Air India, IndiGo and SpiceJet are asking state oil companies to postpone a 25% jet fuel price increase. The Middle East war is driving costs higher.
nfc381a8e15.why: Jet fuel is one of the largest operating costs for airlines, so fuel price changes feed directly into their margins. IndiGo is India's largest listed airline.

n610d85f1a6.headline: Seoul, Tokyo agree to pursue oil, petroleum product swaps amid energy shock
n610d85f1a6.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi agreed to pursue cooperation on crude oil and petroleum product swaps and mutual supplies amid an energy shock.
n610d85f1a6.why: Both countries are large crude importers with limited domestic production, so supply arrangements between them affect energy security and fuel costs across Asia.

n83633eb640.headline: Fuel subsidy available for Davao PUJs, UVs
n83633eb640.summary: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board in Davao is rolling out a P10-per-liter fuel subsidy for jeepney and UV drivers at 43 participating stations.
n83633eb640.why: Fuel subsidies cushion transport operators against fuel price swings and are a common government tool for managing the cost of commuting.

n7695343f7c.headline: Samsung, union narrow some differences as strike nears
n7695343f7c.summary: Samsung Electronics and its South Korean union have narrowed some differences, a mediator said, as government and business groups pressure both sides to avert an imminent and lengthy strike.
n7695343f7c.why: Samsung is one of the world's largest chipmakers and smartphone makers, so a prolonged strike could disrupt global electronics supply.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: A strike at the company would directly affect its production and output.

nb79e0c0e60.headline: Syed Mokhtar Albukhary Emerges As EcoWorld Primary Shareholder
nb79e0c0e60.summary: As part of a corporate restructure, shares in EcoWorld changed hands from Datuk Leong Kok Wah to Tan Sri Syed Mokhtar Albukhary, making him the primary shareholder.
nb79e0c0e60.why: EcoWorld is a Malaysian property developer, and changes in its controlling shareholder can affect its strategy and governance.

na1be404246.headline: Japan and South Korea Deepen Oil Ties as Hormuz Crisis Bites
na1be404246.summary: Japan and South Korea are moving to deepen oil supply cooperation as the Hormuz crisis threatens two of Asia's most import-dependent economies.
na1be404246.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and disruption through the Strait of Hormuz affects a large share of seaborne oil supply.
na1be404246.why_moved: The Hormuz crisis threatens oil supply to import-dependent Japan and South Korea, which are moving to deepen their oil supply cooperation.

n5784c3fea5.headline: Davao Light lowers residential power rates
n5784c3fea5.summary: Davao Light will lower its May residential power rate to P10.35 per kWh, citing lower transmission costs and a freeze on ERC fees.
n5784c3fea5.why: Electricity tariffs affect household budgets and the cost base of businesses in the Philippines' regional distribution networks.

n7936417363.headline: South Koreans Liquidate Savings and Insurance to Chase SK Hynix and Samsung Rally
n7936417363.summary: Korean retail investors are cashing out savings and insurance policies to buy SK Hynix and Samsung shares. The trend raises financial system risks, according to the report.
n7936417363.why: SK Hynix and Samsung are the largest memory chipmakers and heavily weighted in the Korean market, so retail flows can amplify share price swings.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Retail investors are redirecting savings into SK Hynix shares, adding buying pressure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n4fd50dba89.headline: Indonesia cuts MBG budget by Rp67 trillion in 2026 APBN
n4fd50dba89.summary: Indonesia has cut the budget for its Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) programme in the 2026 State Budget from Rp335 trillion to Rp268 trillion, a reduction of Rp67 trillion.
n4fd50dba89.why: The state budget sets government spending priorities, and changes to large programmes affect fiscal deficits and public-sector contractors.

nb535367acf.headline: Indonesia wealth fund INA’s profit up 37% in 2025
nb535367acf.summary: INA reported a profit of 7.45 trillion rupiah for 2025, up from 5.42 trillion rupiah in 2024. The result represents a 37% increase.
nb535367acf.why: INA is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, which invests in state and private projects and shapes the country's infrastructure and capital allocation.

n3d436121af.headline: Pag-IBIG Fund net income up 11% in first quarter
n3d436121af.summary: The Home Development Mutual Fund, known as Pag-IBIG Fund, reported an 11% increase in net income in the first quarter. The rise was driven by robust collections and steady earnings from loans and investments.
n3d436121af.why: Pag-IBIG is a Philippine government housing fund that lends to homebuyers and invests its members' savings, making it a major player in local mortgage and bond markets.

n2730461b49.headline: Indonesia expands rice exports as stocks hit record high: Ministry
n2730461b49.summary: Deputy Minister of Agriculture Sudaryono said Indonesia's abundant rice stocks have strengthened national food security. The country is positioned to expand rice exports.
n2730461b49.why: Indonesia is one of the world's largest rice producers and importers, so its export and stockpiling decisions influence global rice prices and food trade.

na1929006fb.headline: FLI profit rises to P1.1 billion in Q1
na1929006fb.summary: Filinvest Land Inc., the Gotianun family's real estate unit, saw profit rise 3.5% to P1.1 billion in the first quarter. Growth came from residential and retail leasing operations.
na1929006fb.why: Filinvest Land is a Philippine property developer, and its earnings reflect demand for residential housing and retail leasing in Manila.
